laws.t: Employment and Labour Relations Act, 2004, with sectoral wage orders for domestic workers
laws.tp: General labor rights apply to domestic workers; sectoral minimum wages.
laws.s2: Hak kerja umum berlaku bagi pekerja rumah tangga, dengan upah minimum khusus sektor.

coded.vl: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
coded.n: Employment law covers domestic workers; sectoral wage order.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required, no language rule
A separate or lower minimum, or one set only by policy
coded.n: Sectoral minimum wage for domestic workers.

coded.vl: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
Normal hours limited as for other workers
At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
Equal to or longer than for other workers

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.vl: General criminal or civil law only

dec.ct: African Court on Human and Peoples’ Rights
dec.pe: Tanzania declared a man an illegal immigrant, took his passport and expelled him to Kenya, which also refused him. He was left stateless. The African Court said Tanzania must restore his rights.
dec.pi: Tanzania menyatakan seorang pria imigran ilegal, menyita paspornya, dan mengusirnya ke Kenya, yang juga menolaknya. Ia menjadi tanpa kewarganegaraan. Mahkamah Afrika menyatakan Tanzania harus memulihkan haknya.

dec.ct: African Court on Human and Peoples’ Rights
dec.pe: A man born in Tanzania was arrested and held for years as an illegal immigrant. The African Court said the state, not the man, had to prove he was a foreigner.
dec.pi: Seorang pria kelahiran Tanzania ditangkap dan ditahan bertahun-tahun sebagai imigran ilegal. Mahkamah Afrika menyatakan negara, bukan pria itu, yang harus membuktikan ia orang asing.
